description: Public Knoxville-area emergency medicine physician compensation benchmarks. These are market pay signals, not payroll records or guaranteed offers.

summary.interpretation: Public sources suggest Knoxville-area emergency medicine physician compensation commonly appears in the mid-$300k annual range or roughly $166-$273 per hour depending on source methodology, employment model, and whether the figure is salary, posting-derived hourly pay, 1099 income, or peer-reported total compensation.

records.notes: Benchmark model using employer job postings and third-party data sources; useful as a salary benchmark, not facility payroll.
Small sample from job postings over the prior 36 months; may overweight locum, travel, contractor, or high-acuity postings.
Peer-reported Tennessee compensation; broader than Knoxville and subject to self-reporting and employment-model mix.
Very small sample; included only as a directional cross-check.

limitations: Physician pay varies materially by W-2 versus 1099 status, benefits, malpractice coverage, productivity, shift mix, acuity, nocturnist coverage, academic/community setting, and contract group.
Public market benchmarks do not reveal what any specific Knoxville hospital, TeamHealth group, staffing company, or physician actually pays or earns.

Actual physician compensation may include stipends, RVU/productivity pay, night/weekend differentials, medical director pay, sign-on bonuses, retention bonuses, retirement, health benefits, and malpractice coverage.
